import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { userBlocks } from "../../../backend/schema/user_blocks";

// A board over "reasonFormat" fits this table, but a board needs a text column to keep each card's order in. Add one, then declare kanban: { columnField: "reasonFormat", orderField: "<that column>" }.
export const userBlocksCms = customizeTable<typeof userBlocks>("user_blocks", {
    icon: "Users",
    display: {
        title: "reason"
    },
    listFields: ["id", "reasonFormat", "endsAt", "deactivatesAt", "needsView", "user"],
    fields: {
        reason: {
            multiline: true
        }
    },
    fieldOrder: [
        "id",
        "reasonFormat",
        "endsAt",
        "deactivatesAt",
        "needsView",
        "user",
        "creator",
        "revoker",
        "reason",
        "createdAt",
        "updatedAt"
    ]
});
